# MaterialUsage schemas
{: .no_toc}

Detail schemas for material usage rows: one material in one role, as prepared or applied in a procedure, specimen procedure or experimental interface. The role (type) selects the schema.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## How to use this family

- [`materialusage`](/api/modules/materialusage/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `details_json`.
- [`materialusagetemplate`](/api/modules/materialusagetemplate/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `details_json`.
- Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/MaterialUsage/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/MaterialUsage/<Type>.json` is the current version and `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/MaterialUsage/<Type>/` lists the versions. See [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).
- Quantities are objects `{"value": <number>, "unit": "<code>"}`. Property paths with `[]` are inside a repeatable list of rows. The server sets the schema version field itself.

## Devices

### Blood-pressure sensor

- type code `BloodPressureSensor` · version 1.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/MaterialUsage/BloodPressureSensor/1.0.1.json)

A blood-pressure sensor or telemetry transmitter implanted or attached to measure arterial or venous pressure, with its sterility and any surface treatment.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `sterilityStatus` | Sterility status | choice |  | one of `sterile`, `non_sterile`, `unknown` | Sterility status of this material when it was used. |
| `sterilizationMethod` | Sterilization method | choice |  | one of `autoclave`, `ethylene_oxide`, `gamma_irradiation`, `other`, `none`, `unknown` | Method used to sterilize this material. |
| `disinfectionMethod` | Disinfection method | choice |  | one of `alcohol`, `chlorhexidine`, `povidone_iodine`, `other`, `none`, `unknown` | Method used to disinfect this material. |
| `surfaceTreatment` | Surface treatment or coating | text |  |  | Use-specific surface treatment or coating applied to this device or component. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "sterilityStatus": "sterile",
    "sterilizationMethod": "autoclave"
}
```


### Cannula

- type code `Cannula` · version 1.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/MaterialUsage/Cannula/1.0.1.json)

A guide or infusion cannula implanted or inserted for drug or fluid delivery, with its sterility and tip preparation.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `sterilityStatus` | Sterility status | choice |  | one of `sterile`, `non_sterile`, `unknown` | Sterility status of this material when it was used. |
| `sterilizationMethod` | Sterilization method | choice |  | one of `autoclave`, `ethylene_oxide`, `gamma_irradiation`, `other`, `none`, `unknown` | Method used to sterilize this material. |
| `disinfectionMethod` | Disinfection method | choice |  | one of `alcohol`, `chlorhexidine`, `povidone_iodine`, `other`, `none`, `unknown` | Method used to disinfect this material. |
| `tipPreparation` | Tip preparation | choice |  | one of `factory`, `cut`, `beveled`, `polished`, `other`, `unknown` | Final preparation of the device tip for this use. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
    "sterilityStatus": "sterile",
    "sterilizationMethod": "autoclave"
}
```

### ECoG array

- type code `EcogArray` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/MaterialUsage/EcogArray/1.0.0.json)

An ECoG array placed on the cortical surface for electrocorticography, with the number used, sterility, preparation and any surface treatment.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `sterilityStatus` | Sterility status | choice |  | one of `sterile`, `non_sterile`, `unknown` | Sterility status of this material when it was used. |
| `sterilizationMethod` | Sterilization method | choice |  | one of `autoclave`, `ethylene_oxide`, `gamma_irradiation`, `other`, `none`, `unknown` | Method used to sterilize this material. |
| `disinfectionMethod` | Disinfection method | choice |  | one of `alcohol`, `chlorhexidine`, `povidone_iodine`, `other`, `none`, `unknown` | Method used to disinfect this material. |
| `count` | Count used | integer |  | ≥ 1 | Number of arrays used in this record, counted as whole arrays rather than the contacts on them. |
| `preparation` | Preparation | text |  |  | Use-specific preparation of the array before placement, such as trimming the substrate or soaking. |
| `surfaceTreatment` | Surface treatment or coating | text |  |  | Use-specific surface treatment or coating applied to the contacts for this use. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "sterilityStatus": "sterile",
    "sterilizationMethod": "autoclave"
}
```

A coating applied to a device or component before use, such as a lipophilic dye on a probe shank, with the coated area, application method, concentration and number of coats.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|

| `area` | Coated area | text |  |  | Part of the device or component that was coated. |
| `concentration` | Applied concentration | quantity with unit |  | units `M`, `mM`, `µM`, `nM`, `g/L`, `mg/mL`, `µg/mL`, `ng/mL`, `mg/L`, `µg/L`, `ng/L`, `% w/v`, `% v/v`; default `{"unit": "mg/mL"}` | Concentration of this material in the formulation or mixture actually applied. |
| `numberOfCoats` | Number of coats | integer |  | ≥ 1 | Number of coating layers applied. |

Illustrative payload:

### Manual microdrive

- type code `ManualMicrodrive` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/MaterialUsage/ManualMicrodrive/1.0.0.json)

A manually adjusted microdrive that advances an implanted device, such as a screw-driven drive for tetrodes or a silicon probe, with drive mechanism, travel range, travel per turn, retractability, recovery, attachment and sterility.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `actuationMechanism` | Drive mechanism | text |  |  | Manual mechanism used to advance or retract the implanted device. |
| `travelRange` | Microdrive travel range | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Usable range over which the microdrive can move the positioned device. |
| `movementResolution` | Microdrive step size or resolution | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`; default `{"unit": "µm"}` | Smallest position increment reliably achievable by the microdrive. |
| `travelPerTurn` | Travel per full turn | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`; default `{"unit": "µm"}` | Distance the positioned device travels per full turn of the drive screw. |
| `retractable` | Device can be retracted | yes/no |  |  | Whether the microdrive permits the positioned device to be retracted. |
| `deviceRecoverable` | Device can be recovered | yes/no |  |  | Whether the positioned device can be removed from the microdrive for recovery or reuse. |
| `deviceAttachmentMethod` | Device attachment to microdrive | choice |  | one of `clamp`, `screw`, `adhesive`, `friction_fit`, `shuttle_carrier`, `socket`, `other` | How the positioned device is attached to the microdrive. |
| `fixationMethod` | Microdrive fixation method | choice |  | one of `dental_cement`, `skull_screws`, `headcap`, `bone_anchor`, `adhesive`, `mechanical_clamp`, `other` | How the microdrive is secured in its used configuration. |
| `sterilityStatus` | Sterility status | choice |  | one of `sterile`, `non_sterile`, `unknown` | Sterility status of this material when it was used. |
| `sterilizationMethod` | Sterilization method | choice |  | one of `autoclave`, `ethylene_oxide`, `gamma_irradiation`, `other`, `none`, `unknown` | Method used to sterilize this material. |
| `disinfectionMethod` | Disinfection method | choice |  | one of `alcohol`, `chlorhexidine`, `povidone_iodine`, `other`, `none`, `unknown` | Method used to disinfect this material. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "actuationMechanism": "text",
    "travelRange": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "mm"
    }
}
```

## Agents and drugs

### Active agent

- type code `ActiveAgent` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/MaterialUsage/ActiveAgent/1.0.0.json)

The pharmacologically active substance of a formulation given or applied in a procedure, when no more specific drug role fits, with this agent's own dose, concentration, dilution, volume or mass.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `dose` | Applied dose | quantity with unit |  | units `g/kg`, `mg/kg`, `µg/kg`, `ng/kg`; default `{"unit": "mg/kg"}` | This agent's own dose in this record, normalized to body mass; never the mixture's combined dose. |
| `concentration` | Applied concentration | quantity with unit |  | units `M`, `mM`, `µM`, `nM`, `g/L`, `mg/mL`, `µg/mL`, `ng/mL`, `mg/L`, `µg/L`, `ng/L`, `% w/v`, `% v/v`; default `{"unit": "mg/mL"}` | This agent's own strength in the formulation as prepared, not the formulation's overall strength. |
| `dilution` | Applied dilution | ratio |  | format ratio | Ratio by which this agent's own source material was diluted to prepare it for this use. |
| `dilution.numerator` | numerator | number | yes | > 0 |  |
| `dilution.denominator` | denominator | number | yes | > 0 |  |
| `volume` | Applied volume | quantity with unit |  | units `L`, `mL`, `µL`, `nL`; default `{"unit": "mL"}` | Volume this agent itself contributed here — its own share of any total the parent records. |
| `mass` | Applied mass | quantity with unit |  | units `kg`, `g`, `mg`, `µg`, `ng`; default `{"unit": "mg"}` | Absolute amount of this agent contributed here: weighed or fixed, not calculated per body mass. |
| `preparation` | Preparation | text |  |  | Prose about preparing this agent here. Row order already records addition order, and a recipe that must be followed belongs in a linked protocol. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "dose": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "mg/kg"
    },
    "concentration": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "mg/mL"
    }
}
```


### Anesthetic agent

- type code `AnestheticAgent` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/MaterialUsage/AnestheticAgent/1.0.0.json)

An anesthetic drug given for induction or maintenance, with this agent's own dose, concentration and volume, also when it is one component of a cocktail. A vaporizer setting for an inhaled agent belongs on the event, not here.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `dose` | Applied dose | quantity with unit |  | units `g/kg`, `mg/kg`, `µg/kg`, `ng/kg`; default `{"unit": "mg/kg"}` | This agent's own dose in this anesthetic, normalized to body mass; never the cocktail's total. |
| `concentration` | Applied concentration | quantity with unit |  | units `M`, `mM`, `µM`, `nM`, `g/L`, `mg/mL`, `µg/mL`, `ng/mL`, `mg/L`, `µg/L`, `ng/L`, `% w/v`, `% v/v`; default `{"unit": "mg/mL"}` | This agent's own strength in the solution as drawn up; a vaporizer setting belongs on the event. |
| `volume` | Applied volume | quantity with unit |  | units `L`, `mL`, `µL`, `nL`; default `{"unit": "mL"}` | Volume this agent itself contributed to the mixture; an inhaled agent has no volume here. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "dose": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "mg/kg"
    },
    "concentration": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "mg/mL"
    }
}
```
